SELECT s.id, 'SETMEAL' AS product_type, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name, s.name, s.price, s.image_path, s.description, s.sales_count, NULL AS nutrition_tags_json FROM setmeal s JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE s.status = 'ON_SALE' AND m.business_status = 1
AND s.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
AND 1 = 0
AND ( s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
UNION ALL

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.id, 'DISH' AS product_type, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, dc.id AS category_id, dc.name AS category_name, d.name, d.price, d.image_path, d.description, d.sales_count, ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(cn.nutrition_tag) FROM category_nutrition cn WHERE cn.category_id = d.category_id ) AS nutrition_tags_json FROM dish d JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id JOIN dish_category dc ON dc.id = d.category_id WHERE d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND d.status = 'ON_SALE' AND m.business_status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT s.id, 'SETMEAL' AS product_type, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name, s.name, s.price, s.image_path, s.description, s.sales_count, NULL AS nutrition_tags_json FROM setmeal s JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND s.status = 'ON_SALE' AND m.business_status = 1 ) products ORDER BY sales_count DESC, id DESC
